# Home & Me

> Home & Me is a renovation service in Singapore. It designs your own flat for free, then passes your enquiry to the contractor who does the work, who quotes you directly in an itemised format. Site: https://homeandme.sg/

## Who it is for

Homeowners in Singapore planning a renovation. The free design from a floor plan is for HDB flats for now. Condos and landed homes are renovated too: for those, message Home & Me on WhatsApp.

## How it works

- Home & Me designs your flat free, then passes your enquiry to the contractor unedited. The contractor quotes you directly, itemised by trade. Home & Me does not add a line to the quote.
- It costs nothing to enquire: no design fee, no deposit and no showroom appointment.
- The site shows no price list, because a renovation price depends on the unit, its condition and the materials chosen.
- Single rooms can be renovated, for example one toilet or one kitchen.

## How to start a design request today

The request has four steps and takes a few minutes. Start at https://homeandme.sg/journey/upload.html

1. Your details: name, WhatsApp number and email.
2. Design: choose one of seven designs (Modern Classic, Muji, Scandinavian, Minimalist, Contemporary, Industrial, Modern Oriental).
3. Theme: choose one of the design's four themes.
4. Check and send: tick the consent box, then send. Nothing is sent until you tap Send.

After you send, a designer looks at your design and theme, and Home & Me messages you on WhatsApp to confirm the details. The design pictures are free. The pictures on the site are Home & Me design visuals, not photos of a finished home.

## Not offered yet

- Floor plan upload is closed. The site says it opens soon, and that your floor plan is asked for then.
- Paid extras (a walkthrough video, carpentry drawings) are not on sale yet. The site says they are priced on your private page after the photos.
